title: רב אבין

paragraphs: Rav Avin, brother (perhaps it should read nephew) of Rabbi Avin the Levite, said: “There are four proud ones in the world,” Midrash. But I saw at the end of Shemot Rabbah, section 23: “Rabbi Avin said: There are four proud ones.” Midrash Chazit on “He made its pillars silver”: Rabbi Bon in Rabbi Abbahu’s name, “Four proud ones.” Thus Yuchasin has a scribal error.
